item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 16/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry northeast monsoon now affecting Guangdong will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will become humid gradually over the region. It will be warm during the day. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas in the latter part of this week. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will cover southern China.
